units.source_text: 这就是信辅的真心，不知从何时起，他开始憎恨自己对贫穷的憎恨。

en.t: This was Shinsuke's true feeling: at some point, he had begun to hate his own hatred of poverty.

units.source_text: 二十岁之前，他一直被这种双重憎恨所困扰。

en.t: Until he was twenty, he was constantly tormented by this double hatred.

units.source_text: 然而，他也不是一点幸福都没有。

en.t: Yet it was not as though he had no happiness at all.

units.source_text: 每次考试成绩都能名列第三、第四名。

en.t: In every examination, his marks were good enough to place him third or fourth.

units.source_text: 还有低年级的美少年，主动对他示好。

en.t: There was also a beautiful boy in a lower grade who showed him kindness of his own accord.

units.source_text: 但是，这些不过是云天里露出的一点阳光罢了。

en.t: But these were no more than a little sunlight breaking through a cloudy sky.

units.source_text: 憎恨比一切感情都更加沉重的在他心头徘徊。

en.t: Hatred, heavier than any other feeling, lingered in his heart.

units.source_text: 不仅仅是这样，不知从何时开始，憎恨在他心里留下了不可磨灭的印记。

en.t: Nor was that all: from some unknown time onward, hatred had left an indelible mark on his heart.

units.source_text: 即使是摆脱贫穷之后，他依然憎恨贫穷。

en.t: Even after escaping poverty, he still hated poverty.

units.source_text: 与此同时，他憎恨奢侈，就像憎恨贫穷一样。

en.t: At the same time, he hated luxury just as much as he hated poverty.

units.source_text: 他对奢侈的憎恨，就源于对中下层阶级贫穷的印记。

en.t: His hatred of luxury sprang from the mark left by the poverty of the lower middle class.

units.source_text: 亦或是说，是对中下层阶级贫穷的唯一印记。

en.t: Or rather, it was the only mark of that lower middle class poverty.

units.source_text: 时至今日，他仍然能够感受到心头的那种憎恨。

en.t: Even now, he could still feel that hatred in his heart.

units.source_text: 那是不得不时刻准备和贫穷战斗的Petty Bourgeois中产阶级的到的恐惧……

en.t: It was the fear of the petty bourgeois middle class, forced to be ready at every moment to fight against poverty...
